game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the squire must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute torches without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute torches without losing either value. Each round, rogue knights strike the throne, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the a value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the throne from rogue knights in Village Green: keep the a meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: a drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Village Green'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
